# vpsie_file_share_smb (Resource)

SMB access of a file share: whether the share is served over SMB and which SMB users it grants (`vpsie_file_smb_user`). The users must belong to the VPC the share is served in. An enabled share needs at least one user. The platform reports whether SMB is on but not the granted users, so a change to the users made outside Terraform is not detected. Destroying the resource turns SMB off and removes every grant. Needs the `fileStorage` licence module.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_file_share_smb" "data" {
  share_identifier = vpsie_file_share.data.identifier
  enabled          = true

  users = [
    {
      identifier = vpsie_file_smb_user.alice.identifier
      mode       = "rw"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the share is served over SMB.
- `share_identifier` (String) The share identifier (`vpsie_file_share.<name>.identifier`). Changing it replaces the resource.
- `users` (Attributes List) The SMB users the share grants: up to 64, each once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Required:

- `identifier` (String) The SMB user identifier (`vpsie_file_smb_user.<name>.identifier`).

Optional:

- `mode` (String) `rw` (the default) or `ro`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The SMB setting of a share can be imported with the share identifier; the granted users come from the configuration.
terraform import vpsie_file_share_smb.data <share-identifier>
```
